intents.goal: The daily sales report puts our late-evening orders on the next day, so the numbers don't match the cash register. Make the report count each order on the store's own day.
intents.acceptance: dailyTotals groups orders by the calendar day in the store's time zone from src/config.js, and npm test passes.
intents.constraints: Order timestamps come from the server in UTC; keep src/config.js as it is.
